root.label: Trump presents 2026 National Medals of Science and Technology

events.label: Trump presents 2026 National Medals of Science and Technology

slots.name: foreign-born recipients
slots.sentence: Of the six tech leaders who received an award for scientific and technological achievement from the president, five came from abroad.

slots.name: science medal recipients
slots.sentence: The president gave the National Medal of Science to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Google co-founder Sergey Brin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and Lisa Su, CEO of the semiconductor company Advanced Micro Devices.
